context: A child shows a parent a craft project at the kitchen table
purpose: Teach: 華/届き/幕/フード/膝/糸/にくく/りん

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、見て！図工でりんごの絵を描いて、周りに赤い糸で飾りをつけたんだよ。
lines.en: Mom, look! In art class I drew an apple and added decorations around it with red thread.
lines.style: Excited child voice, bright and proud, eagerly presenting their finished artwork.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: わあ、本当に華やかね。糸を縫い付けるの、難しかったでしょう？
lines.en: Wow, it's really gorgeous. Sewing the thread on must have been hard, right?
lines.style: Warm motherly voice, genuinely impressed, leaning in to admire her child's careful work.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: うん、糸が硬くて針が通りにくくて、何回も失敗しちゃった。
lines.en: Yeah, the thread was stiff and hard to push the needle through, so I messed up a bunch of times.
lines.style: Slightly complaining but proud child, recounting the difficulty with animated expression.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 膝の上で縫ったの？危ないから、今度は机でやろうね。
lines.en: Did you sew it on your lap? That's dangerous, so next time let's do it at the desk.
lines.style: Caring mother voice, gentle concern mixed with practical advice for everyday safety.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あとね、パパに手紙も書いたの。ちゃんと届きますように。
lines.en: Also, I wrote a letter to Dad too. I hope it reaches him properly.
lines.style: Hopeful, slightly shy child voice, sharing a heartfelt wish about a faraway parent.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: きっと届くわよ。あ、フードかぶったままじゃ暑いでしょ、脱いだら？
lines.en: It'll definitely reach him. Oh, you must be hot with your hood still on—why not take it off?
lines.style: Reassuring then shifting to practical mom mode, attentive to her child's comfort.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あ、本当だ。発表会で幕が開くのをずっと待ってたから、まだドキドキしてて忘れてた。
lines.en: Oh, you're right. I was waiting for the curtain to open at the recital, so my heart's still pounding and I forgot.
lines.style: Self-aware child laughing softly, recalling an earlier exciting school event naturally.

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ふふ、発表会も頑張ったもんね。お茶でも飲みながら、ゆっくり絵を見せて。
lines.en: Haha, you worked hard at the recital too. Let's have some tea while you show me the picture slowly.
lines.style: Affectionate laughing mother, doting and inviting a cozy quiet moment together at the table.
